research.notes: Not confirmed to be the same entity as the OUSD vendor. The agenda lists Fairfield, CA, but the agency's website lists offices in San Francisco and New York. The only Fairfield link is the California LLC 'P. Navalta Content Strategies LLC' (entity number 202022310855, 4680 Lariat Drive, Fairfield, CA 94534, per bizprofile.net, a third-party aggregator), led by the same founder; no cited page states that this LLC operates as Navalta Media, and that address appears to be non-public/possibly residential so it was not used.
